text:
marie: Heads up — ap-south1 mosaic-4b queue depth jumped to 5.4k (p90 enqueue latency 1.2s). Seeing backlog mostly from low-priority webhooks.

infra-bot: Metric alert: queue_depth[mosaic-4b@ap-south1] > 5000 for 3m. Autothrottle not triggered (policy: per-region fairshare).

kevin: I'm on it. Is this from a single customer or many small spikes?

marie: Mixed. ~40% from acme corp batch jobs (bursting), rest from many small pollers.

sam: @kevin @marie recommend temporary admission-control: tighten per-customer QPS to 0.8x and enable model-variant fallback (mosaic-4b -> mosaic-3b-quant) for best-effort tier.

lee: Quant variant does change token quality for long-form. Need evals for top webhook prompts. Can we limit fallback to short seqs <512?

kevin: Good call. Will push policy: region throttle 15% global, customer cap 0.8x, fallback allowed for seq_len<=512 only. Pushing patch.

kevin: policy patch snippet:
```
admission_control:
  region: ap-south1
  global_throttle: 0.15
  per_customer_multiplier: 0.8
  fallback:
    allowed: true
    models: [mosaic-3b-quant]
    max_seq_len: 512
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: admission-controller@canary -> ap-south1 config v2025-11-14-01

kevin: Applied. Observability: added temporary dashboard and tracing tag "triage-ap-south1-mosaic4b".

marie: Early signals: queue depth down to 3.1k in last 4m, p90 enqueue 600ms. Still high but trending.

nora: Cost note — fallback to 3b-quant will reduce GPU cycles ~30%, but increased request retries might offset. Monitor cost per token.

sam: Oncall will watch for SLA regression. If error rate + latency > threshold we rollback. Tagging incident channel #incidents for visibility.

marie: Thanks. Also start a short-term customer outreach for top 10 spike sources to ask for rate smoothing. I'll draft a template.

kevin: Logging note: added per-request header X-Admission-Reason for debugging.

infra-bot: Alert cleared for queue_depth after reduction below 4000 for 5m.

sam: Closing triage in 30m unless we see new surge. :thumbsup:
